# Nexus HQ

> Nexus HQ is an all-in-one workspace for team operations — attendance, tasks, standups, OKRs, KPIs, deliverables, and AI-powered insights for modern teams.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Nexus HQ — the unified workspace for team operations.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans (Basic, Enterprise, Unlimited), pricing, 7-day free trial and 30% annual discount.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create a new workspace and start the 7-day free trial.
- [Log in](/login): Sign in to an existing Nexus HQ workspace.
